title: When Does Dynamics Randomization Test Context Inference?
abstract: arXiv:2610.32414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Environments with randomized dynamics are widely used to ask whether world models need explicit context inference. However, randomization can leave little predictive information for a context encoder to add, because distinct latent parameters may produce similar transitions at visited states, or those states may already reveal the active context. We formalize the remaining one-step information as predictive headroom and compare kernels under fixed and visited state--action distributions to distinguish changes in query coverage from changes in context weights. We analyze discrete and continuous environments and find low headroom both when kernels differ little and when visitation reduces an otherwise large discrepancy. At the same time, resetting state components increases headroom, showing that context evidence accumulates in state. translated_title: 动力学随机化何时能真正检验上下文推断？
translated_abstract: 采用随机化动力学的环境被广泛用于探究世界模型是否需要显式的上下文推断。然而，随机化可能只为上下文编码器留下很少可供补充的预测信息，因为不同的潜在参数可能在访问过的状态上产生相似的转移，或者这些状态本身可能已经揭示了当前的上下文。我们将剩余的单步可预测信息形式化为“预测余量”，并通过在固定分布与实际访问的状态-动作分布下比较核函数，来区分查询覆盖范围的变化与上下文权重的变化。我们分析了离散和连续环境，发现当核函数之间差异很小，或当访问分布缩小了原本较大的差异时，预测余量都很低。与此同时，重置状态分量会增加预测余量，这表明上下文证据是在状态中逐步累积的。我们建议在报告随机化参数的同时报告这一预测余量指标，以便衡量显式上下文推断所带来的收益。
tldr: 论文提出“预测余量”这一形式化指标来量化随机动力学环境中上下文编码器可获得的额外预测信息，发现许多环境下该余量很低，并建议将其与随机化参数一同报告，以判断显式上下文推断是否真正带来收益。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes "predictive headroom" to quantify the remaining one-step predictive information available to context encoders in dynamics-randomized environments, shows it is often low in practice, and proposes reporting it alongside the randomized parameters to assess whether explicit context inference truly yields gains.
